race.comment: MOSCOW MAID (8) back for her second campaign with a slick on pace win over 1000m at Hawkesbury. Big jump in grade from the good draw with a respectable fourth over 1100m at Canterbury in a solid contest. Will find this more to her liking with the fitness edge. FOVEA (6) backed up the good trial form on debut as the dominant fav, when she led throughout to score in fast time over 1000m at Kembla Grange. Can progress quickly second up and remain unbeaten. CRESCENT KING (1) showed good early speed on debut from the wide gate when recording a tough Maiden win over 1100m at Canterbury. Jumps in weight but is drawn soft. Shaping up nicely and must be included. MISS SCANDAL (4) returns from a spell. Coming along well including a recent trial win at Rosehill. Opened last campaign with a fifth at Canterbury over 1100m. Include.
